rising.description: An agent skill that finds where a photo was taken — OpenStreetMap geometry, elevation skylines, satellite imagery and street view — and shows its work. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and GitHub Copilot.

Installs across several AI coding agents
Shows reasoning and evidence overlays

Geolocating people's photos could raise privacy concerns

rising.description: Continuously updated catalogue of open-source OSINT tools, skills, plugins, MCP servers, and agentic integrations.

Multiple views: by category, target input, emerging and agentic projects
Provides a machine-readable CSV database
risks: Curated list only; contains no runnable tool itself
Catalogue quality depends on maintenance of linked projects

rising.description: Open-source intelligence and human-rights hub on North Korea: intel map, missile test explorer, leadership graph, camps and verified data.
rising.summary: Open-source hub on North Korea offering an intel map of camps and military sites, a missile test explorer, leadership graph, North vs South data and 25 open datasets, each fact sourced.
strengths: Sourced facts with weekly automated data refresh
Open datasets and Apache 2.0 license
Multilingual interface
risks: Political subject matter; sources and framing need review
Data accuracy depends on upstream sources

rising.description: OSINT toolkit for crypto investigations: trace stolen funds on Ethereum, Bitcoin, Tron and Solana — CLI and local web UI
rising.summary: Open-source OSINT toolkit that traces stolen cryptocurrency across Ethereum, Bitcoin, Tron, Solana and TON via CLI and local web UI, showing balances, risk scores, fund-flow trees and token freezes.

Honest limitations section on pseudonymity and mixers
risks: Mentions a specific case write-up; claims are unverified
Relies on rate-limited public endpoints

rising.description: Real-time tactical OSINT & GEOINT dashboard. Live flight tracking (ADS-B), maritime vessels, satellites, undersea telecom cables & HUD shaders powered by free, keyless open APIs.

rising.description: Offline desktop workspace for organizing OSINT investigations.

Clear feature list with investigation data management
Tests and CI workflow documented
risks: Does not itself collect OSINT data; value depends on user workflow
Binary release targets Windows x64 only
Limited detail on usage examples

rising.description: Free, open-source desktop app that estimates where a photo was taken. Self-contained, Windows, no paid APIs.
rising.summary: Windows desktop app that takes an outdoor photo, uses a PLONK neural network for coarse location, checks sun position, and verifies matches against Mapillary, Street View and Panoramax imagery on a map.

Clear multi-stage method with named data sources
Documents an ethical-use section
risks: Geolocation of photos could be misused for stalking if not careful; README includes ethical caveat
Relies on Google Street View imagery which may have terms restrictions

rising.description: Ferramenta de extração e descoberta de URLs para fluxos de OSINT e reconhecimento
rising.summary: Python CLI (SRURL) that takes seed URLs, fetches pages and extracts reachable URLs, with passive and active sources, same-origin spidering, recursive rounds, API-key sources, profiles, and Docker support.
strengths: Clear usage documentation with many flags and examples
Modular source plugin architecture
Docker and profile presets

Active probing with verify=False in example code

rising.description: Browser extension and web app that flags paid or planted sources in AI chatbot answers. Evidence, never a true/false verdict. English and Arabic.

Measured false-positive benchmarks published in badges and tests
Reproducible builds with SBOM and checksums
risks: Heuristic source flagging may mislabel legitimate publishers

rising.description: Karnak — a live OSINT situational monitor: a wall of live streams, an AI situation brief, a fused news timeline, market indicators, and a network-reachability watch. Named for Ozymandias's monitor wall in Watchmen.

Multiple named public sources and features
Explicit no-tracking and no-login stance

Relies on third-party APIs and keys such as TikTok signing service

rising.description: Watchdog (branding subject to change) is an open-source intelligence (OSINT) case management platform for small teams.
rising.summary: Open-source case management platform for small OSINT teams. Lookups from Caps produce evidence and proposals that a person must accept before entering a shared case graph, with exports regenerated from it.

Clear architecture stack documented with badges and CI

Capability list and specific data sources are not detailed in the excerpt

rising.description: `GitHub` `Markdown` `OSINT` `Research` - Country-by-country dossiers on the global surveillance industry, spyware vendors, state agencies and Palantir.

Clear install steps and a worked example of tool output

rising.description: Map your photos automatically using embedded EXIF GPS data and Streamlit. Any business inquiry at : projectcisa.contact@gmail.com or projectcisa@proton.me

rising.description: Investigación documental y OSINT: documentos primarios, reconstrucción societaria, auditoría de datos públicos, estadística propia y arquitectura de evidencia.

rising.description: The planet's live traffic on a 3D globe, on your phone: earthquakes, aircraft, satellites, ships, fires and weather. Native Android, free and open source.

situational-awareness.description: Karnak — a live OSINT situational monitor: a wall of live streams, an AI situation brief, a fused news timeline, market indicators, and a network-reachability watch. Named for Ozymandias's monitor wall in Watchmen.
situational-awareness.summary: Pantau (codename Karnak) is a single-page Docker web dashboard that monitors civic events such as Indonesian protests via live YouTube streams, an LLM situation brief, merged Google News and RSS timeline, volcano alerts, markets, and platform reachability checks.
strengths: Clear setup via Docker Compose and optional API keys
Multiple named public sources and features
Explicit no-tracking and no-login stance
risks: Reachability probing from residential connection may raise legal considerations
Relies on third-party APIs and keys such as TikTok signing service
Project appears early-stage with a placeholder clone URL

situational-awareness.description: Every public signal of the war in Ukraine on one live map: air threats, alerts, the front line, military air and sea, satellites and forecasts. EDTH London 2026.
situational-awareness.summary: Live map fusing 25+ open streams on the war in Ukraine: Air Force threat reports, alert map, DeepStateMap front line, military ADS-B aircraft, satellites, news, with forecasts and source links.
strengths: Integrates many named open sources into one live map
Links each fact to its source and publishes model scorecards
Has a live demo, 128 tests and a stated open-data-only policy
risks: Event-driven war monitoring may be used for targeting-adjacent purposes
Forecasts of landing sites and danger are model outputs with uncertain accuracy
Hackathon project; long-term maintenance uncertain

situational-awareness.description: The planet's live traffic on a 3D globe, on your phone: earthquakes, aircraft, satellites, ships, fires and weather. Native Android, free and open source.
situational-awareness.summary: Native Android and Windows app that draws live public feeds (earthquakes, aircraft, satellites, ships, fires, weather, news conflicts) on a 3D globe, with no backend or account required.
strengths: Clear named public data sources with a data sources table
Works without keys for core layers
Open source GPL-3.0 licensed
risks: Primarily a visualisation app rather than investigation tooling
Some layers depend on third-party API keys

situational-awareness.description: OSINT-карта событий в Украине и России на основе публичных Telegram-каналов
situational-awareness.summary: A live interactive Leaflet map aggregating public Telegram channel events, DeepStateMap control zones and Project Owl layers for Ukraine and Russia, with user-drawn zones and every event linked to its source.
strengths: Names specific data sources and layers
Links each event to its original source
Clear neutrality and disclaimer statements
risks: Politically sensitive war-related content with possible partisan source selection
Frontline data is approximate by its own admission
Relies on Supabase and GitHub Actions scraping that could break

social-media.description: Open-source, local-first social media research agent for Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn. Jev routes read-only steps; socai CLI captures cited browser evidence.
social-media.summary: Open-source local-first agent that uses Jev to route read-only research steps while the socai CLI runs them in the user's Chrome, producing source-cited reports on Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn.
strengths: Local-first, runs in the user's own browser session
Produces source-cited reports with recorded evidence examples
Runnable via npx with documented onboarding steps
risks: Uses signed-in personal accounts, raising platform terms and privacy concerns
Heavy marketing claims such as '#1 Tool of the Day' without methodology detail
Depends on an external LLM provider key and a separate socai CLI

social-media.description: Pure standalone, zero-browser Meta Threads intelligence engine & CLI. Cloud API & SaaS at https://skelepel.id
social-media.summary: Node.js CLI and library that scrapes Meta Threads profiles, timelines, keyword search results and reply trees over HTTP without a browser, with optional local SQLite dataset storage. Also promotes a paid cloud service for lead extraction.
strengths: Clear CLI commands and usage examples
Local SQLite dataset storage with deduplication
No browser dependency, fast HTTP-based collection
risks: Promotes commercial lead extraction service alongside the tool
Scraping a platform may violate its terms of service
Profile and post extraction raises personal data concerns

social-media.description: Instagram OSINT toolkit: Playwright-based harvester for profiles, posts, followers & following, plus ig-analyzer — a live local analysis dashboard with engagement, posting-pattern and bio-intel metrics.
social-media.summary: A Node.js and Playwright tool that drives a logged-in Chrome over CDP to harvest Instagram profiles, posts, comments, followers and media into local files, plus a live local dashboard (ig-analyzer) for engagement and posting-pattern analysis.
strengths: Documents CLI flags, config layering, output formats and an analytics dashboard
Clear disclaimer citing legal compliance and privacy laws
risks: Scrapes Instagram against its Terms of Service using logged-in accounts, with account-ban risk
Bulk follower and comment harvesting of individuals enables profiling without consent

social-media.description: Instagram Scraper — free, open-source Instagram scraper. Unlimited profiles, posts, reels, comments and hashtags as clean JSON, no API key, no proxies.
social-media.summary: A free, open-source Instagram scraper exposed as a local API that returns profile, post, reel, comment and hashtag data as JSON, with example outputs and endpoint documentation.
strengths: Working local API with curl example
Clear JSON output examples for profiles
Covers profiles, posts, comments, hashtags and locations
risks: Scraping may violate Instagram terms of service
Promotional wording like unlimited and no proxies with few stated limits
Topics include email scraping, raising personal-data concerns

social-media.description: Export the complete follower list of any public X (Twitter) account to CSV + JSONL.
social-media.summary: A Python CLI that exports the complete follower list of a public X account to CSV and JSONL using the user's own session cookies, with resume checkpoints, multi-session rotation and documented options.
strengths: Clear usage examples and option table
Resume checkpoint and multi-session rotation
Documents how to re-extract API identifiers when they change
risks: Uses personal session cookies and likely violates X Terms of Service, as the README admits
Mass follower harvesting of individuals with account-takeover-like credential handling
Relies on undocumented internal API that may break

social-media.description: Archive any public Instagram account — posts, Reels, video frames, speech transcripts and comments — onto your own computer, from one dashboard in your browser. Resumable, duplicate-safe, exports to CSV/JSON.
social-media.summary: A self-hosted tool that archives public Instagram accounts (posts, Reels, frames, transcripts, comments) into local files and SQLite, with resumable runs, CSV/JSON export and a browser dashboard. Aimed at competitor research.
strengths: Resumable and duplicate-safe collection
Exports to CSV and JSON with a local SQLite store
Documents failure handling and tests
risks: Scrapes Instagram, which may violate its terms of service
Bulk profile archiving of accounts raises privacy concerns
Marketing-oriented framing for competitor research

social-media.description: Instagram OSINT Framework to extract public profiles, posts, reels, comments, mentions, hashtags, and places from Instagram using the Apify API. 🕵🏽‍♂️
social-media.summary: Python CLI that uses the Apify Instagram Scraper API to pull public Instagram profiles, posts, reels, comments, mentions, hashtags and places, saving results as JSON and TXT reports.
strengths: Clear command-line usage examples for each scrape type
Batch processing and timestamped JSON/TXT reports
Documents supported systems and setup steps
risks: Relies on a paid third-party Apify API key
Mass profile extraction could enable tracking of individuals
Disclaimer is generic with limited legal detail

social-media.description: Claude Code skill that reads public Telegram: channels without an account, groups with yours
social-media.summary: A Claude Code skill that reads public Telegram channels without an account via t.me/s pages and searches full history; groups require the user's own Telegram account. Returns structured post records with permalinks, dates, links, and reactions.
strengths: Works without account or API key for public channels
Structured output with permalinks and dates for verification
Includes a demo run and documented limits
risks: Group access uses the user's own Telegram account, raising account-use and ToS considerations
Scraping individual channels' full history could be used for monitoring people

social-media.description: Extract public TikTok post links from the browser — OSINT & forensics guides (AR/EN)
social-media.summary: A browser-console JavaScript script that auto-scrolls a public TikTok profile and downloads a text file of post links, plus AR/EN OSINT and digital forensics guides and ethics documentation.
strengths: Runs in the browser with no installation
Clear step-by-step usage instructions
Includes legal and ethical guidelines and a self-XSS warning
risks: Targets individual accounts, enabling profile extraction
Pasting console code carries Self-XSS risk, which the README itself flags
Coverage limits on large accounts are acknowledged but unresolved

social-media.description: High-end Telegram OSINT Toolkit built with Telethon. Bulk keyword search, chat export, member enumeration, proxy/Tor support & SQLite. For cybersecurity & intelligence work.
social-media.summary: Python CLI built on Telethon for searching, exporting, monitoring and enumerating members of public Telegram channels and groups, with proxy/Tor support and SQLite storage. Requires Telegram API credentials.
strengths: Concrete CLI commands with example inputs and outputs
Clear requirements list and setup steps
Supports bulk keyword search and SQLite persistence
risks: Member enumeration and user profiling could enable tracking of individuals
Legal notice is present but enforcement is not described
Marketing language such as 'High-end' and 'Production Ready' is unsupported

web-capture.description: Ferramenta de extração e descoberta de URLs para fluxos de OSINT e reconhecimento
web-capture.summary: Python CLI (SRURL) that takes seed URLs, fetches pages and extracts reachable URLs, with passive and active sources, same-origin spidering, recursive rounds, API-key sources, profiles, and Docker support.
strengths: Clear usage documentation with many flags and examples
Modular source plugin architecture
Docker and profile presets
risks: README is Portuguese-only digest with limited legal notes visible
Active probing with verify=False in example code

web-capture.description: Ferramenta de dorking em múltiplos motores de busca para coleta de URLs em operações de OSINT e reconhecimento.
web-capture.summary: Python CLI that runs search dorks in parallel across multiple search engines (web, code, pastes, leaks) and returns the union of found URLs, with an embedded dork catalogue and usage examples.
strengths: Clear input modes: free dork, dork file, embedded category catalogue, stdin
Documented usage examples and Docker install options
Parallel querying across many sources
risks: Legal warning about attacking targets without consent is present but brief
Bypass of search engines via browser automation may violate terms of service
Leak-oriented dork categories could be used for exposure hunting

web-capture.description: High-Performance Wayback Machine CDX Recon & Triage Workspace for Chrome (Manifest V3). Stream archived URLs, rank by security risk, verify live 200s, and export.
web-capture.summary: Chrome MV3 extension that streams Wayback Machine CDX archived URLs, ranks them by security risk (.env, keys, .git, SQL dumps), verifies live 200 responses via HEAD requests, and exports results.
strengths: Streams large CDX result sets without freezing the browser
Explicit risk tiers for sensitive file types
Clear installation steps for unpacked load
risks: Security-oriented framing (bug bounty) could be used to hunt exposed secrets on third-party sites
Active HEAD verification touches target hosts

web-capture.summary: Python CLI that queries a CIRCL-hosted Common Crawl metadata index and retrieves only selected WARC byte ranges, supporting URL, FQDN, digest and passive-DNS style searches without downloading full crawls. Access requires a token issued by CIRCL on request.
strengths: Queries metadata index first, avoiding full crawl downloads
Multiple search modes including FQDN, domain and digest lookups
Documented install and configuration steps
risks: Depends on access credentials granted at CIRCL's discretion
Search can be slow with --alltime
README is truncated in places

web-capture.description: GOBLIN TSUNAMI - OSINT framework generating 400+ Google Dorks across Instagram, Threads, Facebook & TikTok. Advanced digital footprint analysis with 25+ tracking categories for cybersecurity professionals, threat intelligence, and ethical reconnaissance operations.

workspace-analysis.description: Watchdog (branding subject to change) is an open-source intelligence (OSINT) case management platform for small teams.
workspace-analysis.summary: Open-source case management platform for small OSINT teams. Lookups from Caps produce evidence and proposals that a person must accept before entering a shared case graph, with exports regenerated from it.
strengths: Human-in-the-loop acceptance of machine output supports defensible provenance
Clear architecture stack documented with badges and CI
risks: Pre-1.0 and explicitly not hardened for production or multi-tenant use
Capability list and specific data sources are not detailed in the excerpt

workspace-analysis.description: Offline desktop workspace for organizing OSINT investigations.
workspace-analysis.summary: OpenTrace is an offline, privacy-focused PySide6 desktop app for organizing OSINT investigations. It offers a visual investigation board, tasks, verification queue, sources, hypotheses, journal, SHA-256 integrity info, and PNG/JSON export.
strengths: Fully offline with no telemetry or accounts
Clear feature list with investigation data management
Tests and CI workflow documented
risks: Does not itself collect OSINT data; value depends on user workflow
Binary release targets Windows x64 only
Limited detail on usage examples
